CONS.description: Constraint Supports (CONS). Keyed by node number; ITEMS carries one constraint entry per boundary group applied to that node, each defining the 7-DOF fixity string.

ITEMS.description: Array of constraint entries for the node. Each entry pairs an optional boundary group with a 7-character DOF constraint string.

ID.description: Serial number of this constraint entry within the node. 0 lets the program resolve/assign the serial from the boundary group; used to target an existing entry for replace.

GROUP_NAME.description: Boundary group name this constraint belongs to. Empty means no group (group key 0). If a non-empty name is given it must reference an existing boundary group, otherwise the request is rejected.

CONSTRAINT.description: 7-character DOF constraint string in order (DX,DY,DZ,RX,RY,RZ,RW). Each character: 1 = constrained, 0 = free. RW is warping torsion. E.g. '1111000' constrains all translations and RX.
